objective: Add an EARLY STRUCTURAL INVALIDATION exit to the CRT trade object: when a candle CLOSES beyond the ORIGIN (open) of the specific displacement candle that activated the setup, the structural thesis that justified the entry has failed, so the position is closed at market instead of waiting for the geometric stop. Purpose is to fractionalise the 1R loss on trades whose premise is already falsified. Config-gated, DEFAULT OFF; the default arm must be byte-identical to today.
why_this_is_rankable: F-087 established that the extreme-following half of the dynamic-stop grid (ratchet_*, breakeven_*) cannot be ranked from M15 OHLC at all: its same-bar ambiguity band is 0.261R mean over the 12 arms it governs, 12x-15x the 0.0198-0.0212R policy spread being measured. This rule is triggered by a CANDLE CLOSE, not by a running extreme, so it inherits the ambiguity profile of the licensed arms (fixed, production, time_decay_*), whose band is ~0.0005R. It is therefore measurable on the existing corpus without tick data. This is the ONLY component of the user's 2026-08-21 CRT draft that is both new and cleanly rankable.

ontology_first.required_by: CLAUDE.md 6.6 - the concept must exist as a canonical node BEFORE the code that implements it, never as a TODO or comment.
ontology_first.description: A CLOSE-triggered structural-failure exit, distinct from both the stop PLACEMENT geometry (SEM-017) and the path-following stop POLICY class (SEM-019). It does not move the stop; it terminates the trade on a semantic condition - the displacement that founded the setup has been negated.
ontology_first.mathematical_definition: For a LONG activated by displacement candle d, the setup is invalidated at the first bar t > entry_bar with close(t) < open(d). For a SHORT, the first bar t with close(t) > open(d). Exit is booked at close(t), not at open(d). Direction is inherited from F-074: displacement is a directional impulse away from the swept side, so `origin` is unambiguous.

known_invariants: Close-triggered, so it carries the licensed same-bar ambiguity profile (~0.0005R), not the 0.261R extreme-following band (F-087).
It can only ever exit EARLIER than the geometric stop when it fires, so per-trade loss magnitude is bounded above by the unmodified arm on those trades.
It cannot create expectancy the entry did not contain (F-087 line 1: gross expectancy is ~0 at the every-bar level).
epistemic.unknown_mechanism: Whether truncating structurally-falsified trades removes more loss than it forgoes in trades that recover after briefly closing through the displacement origin. Unmeasured.
candidate_hypotheses: UNTESTED: the truncated population is disproportionately the 90.55% plain_stop_loss cohort of F-025.
UNTESTED: recovery-after-origin-breach is common enough to make the rule net-negative, which is the mechanism that made every ratchet arm worse in F-087.
epistemic.resolution_metric: Paired per-bar delta vs the unmodified arm on the SEM-018 label population, block-bootstrapped at horizon, with the F-083 controls attached.
falsification_conditions: Mean delta vs the do-nothing arm is <= 0 with a CI excluding a positive effect.
The arm fails to beat long_only / random_entry on the same bars.
